Note at the Bottom of the Chest
dialogues.text: "Haha, not that that idiot will be able to find this chest."

dialogues.speaker: Note at the Bottom of the Chest
dialogues.text: "To whomsoever is reading this note, here's another piece of good news for you."

dialogues.speaker: Note at the Bottom of the Chest
dialogues.text: "That glass house... the one near that Para some Dhya thing, the one with the Nilotpala Lotus pond? There's some other good stuff there."

dialogues.speaker: Note at the Bottom of the Chest
dialogues.text: "It's so close by but that dummy's head is full of research and academic papers. Totally clueless! Hehe!"
